name: La Crema
serverNotes:
📖 ABOUT: Medium-bodied California Chardonnay from La Crema, Monterey. Balanced, approachable style - crowd-pleasing & reliable!

🍷 STYLE: Classic Chardonnay | Apple, pear, vanilla & butter notes | Partial oak aging adds richness | California elegance.

🍽️ PAIRS WITH: Seafood, poultry, cream sauces, lobster, scallops.

💡 BY THE GLASS: Versatile Chardonnay that works with everything. Perfect house white!

name: Rombauer
serverNotes:
📖 ABOUT: Full-bodied, luxurious Chardonnay from Rombauer, Carneros. Cult classic - highly sought after! Premium by-the-glass offering.

🍷 STYLE: Rich Chardonnay | Ripe tropical fruit, butter & toasty oak | Creamy texture from malolactic fermentation | Napa luxury.

🍽️ PAIRS WITH: Lobster, scallops, rich poultry dishes, crab, cream sauces.

💡 BY THE GLASS: THE cult Chardonnay everyone asks for. Buttery, rich, indulgent!
